newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania 130 bln lei T-bill issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romania 130 bln lei T-bill issue oversubscribed.

text.p: An issue of 130 billion lei worth of three-month treasury bills was heavily oversubscribed on Wednesday, when 11 bidders entered a total 307.97 billion lei for the finance ministry's offer.
The T-bills bear an annual yield of 45 percent, a central bank statement showed. The previous yield was slightly higher at 46 percent.

The bids ranged from 36 to 60 percent. Some 101 billion lei went to commercial banks operating in Romania, including branches and subsidiaries of foreign banks, and 28.75 billion lei went to their corporate clients.
Operators said Wednesday's T-bill issue had not been sufficient to drain excess leu funds from the money market, adding that the central bank should implement new tools to regulate the flows.
The market has been overliquid in lei in recent weeks due to frequent dollar purchases by the central bank to prevent the leu from firming and keep exports attractive.
